plan.title: F2 - Classify QoS across all 20 .userInitiated sites

narratives.Overview: Long-running batch work runs at .userInitiated, pinning performance cores at high clock for multi-minute operations.
narratives.Problem:
The audit reported 3 sites. Verification found 20 across 12 files -- ActorGridView, ActorLibraryExportView, ActorLibraryImportView (x2), ActorSyncView (x2), AppComponents, ContentView, DashboardComponents, DashboardView, DuplicateDetectionView (x2), LibraryBackupView (x4), LibraryStatsView, LibraryTransferView (x3) -- with only 2 uses of .utility/.background in the entire app.

This is a codebase-wide default, not three oversights. .userInitiated means 'the user is blocked on this', which is right for a tap-to-response action and wrong for fingerprinting 1,000+ videos.
narratives.Action: Classify every site as interactive (user waiting -- keep .userInitiated) or batch (long-running -- .utility, or .background where the user is not watching). Record the rationale per site. Document the convention in the repo so new work inherits it.
narratives.Constraint: Success shows up as reduced thermal escalation and energy, NOT reduced wall-clock. A downgraded scan may legitimately take longer.
